output.reason: Weeks of hopelessness with a new thought last night that everyone would be better off without him/her requires a hands-on mental health crisis evaluation today, which messaging cannot provide.
output.patientMessage: Please get an in-person mental health crisis assessment today — walk into an urgent behavioral health clinic or emergency department, and call or text 988 now to talk it through while you arrange this. Weeks of hopelessness plus thoughts that others would be better off without you need face-to-face evaluation. If you start thinking about acting on these thoughts, or cannot get seen today, call 911 or go to the emergency department immediately. Ask someone you trust to stay with you and keep medications or weapons out of reach.
